result:
I’d make it safe to change your mind.

No humiliation. No exile from your community. No having to defend forever something you believed before you knew better. Just: *I was wrong. I’ve learned something.*

I think an astonishing amount of cruelty is really loyalty to an old mistake. If people could revise themselves without losing dignity or belonging, the world might become not only wiser, but gentler.
